nights.title: Hande Yener
nights.name: Hande Yener
nights.extract: Makbule Hande Özyener, known professionally as Hande Yener, is a Turkish singer and songwriter. She made her debut in the early 2000s, and since then has become a prominent figure of Turkish pop music with numerous songs that topped the music charts. Alongside her music career, she is also known for her choice of clothes and has renewed her image multiple times over the years. She has occasionally made changes in her music style as well; for a while, she started making electronic music, but this period was short-lived and she again returned to performing pop music. de.kicker: türkische sängerin und songwriterin · debüt anfang der 2000er
de.who: Makbule Hande Özyener, bekannt als Hande Yener, ist eine türkische Sängerin und Songwriterin. Sie debütierte Anfang der 2000er und wurde zu einer prominenten Figur des türkischen Pop mit zahlreichen Chart-Hits. Außerdem ist sie für ihre Kleidung bekannt und hat ihr Image mehrfach erneuert.
facts: Sie debütierte Anfang der 2000er und ist seitdem eine prominente Figur des türkischen Pop mit zahlreichen Songs, die die Charts anführten.
Eine Zeit lang machte sie elektronische Musik, diese Phase war aber kurz und sie kehrte zum Popgesang zurück.

tr.kicker: türk şarkıcı ve söz yazarı · 2000'lerin başında debut
tr.who: Makbule Hande Özyener, sahne adıyla Hande Yener, Türk bir şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. 2000'lerin başında debut yaptı ve listelerin zirvesine çıkan çok sayıda şarkısıyla Türk pop müziğinin önde gelen isimlerinden biri oldu. Kıyafetleriyle de tanınır ve görüntüsünü defalarca yeniledi.
facts: 2000'lerin başında debut yaptı ve o zamandan beri listelerin zirvesine çıkan çok sayıda şarkısıyla Türk pop müziğinin önde gelen isimlerinden biri oldu.
Bir süre elektronik müzik yaptı, ancak bu dönem kısa sürdü ve pop müziğe geri döndü.

nights.title: Pinhani
nights.name: Pinhani
nights.extract: Pinhâni is a Turkish alternative rock band. It was founded on 5 April 2004 by two cousins Sinan Kaynakçı and Zeynep Eylül Üçer as a modern rock band in Turkey. Pinhani have released several albums. Pinhani also made the soundtrack for the Turkish TV Series 'Kavak Yelleri'.

nights.title: Yüksek Sadakat
nights.name: Yüksek Sadakat
nights.extract: Yüksek Sadakat is a Turkish rock band that was formed in 1997 by Kutlu Özmakinacı, but became popular in early 2006 with their first album with the same name. The founder and bass player Kutlu Özmakinacı, used to be the editor of a music magazine called Blue Jean. Their music is a mix of pop rock with powerful beats utilizing Turkish instruments, keyboard and guitar solos. The name of the band is a literal translation of the term High Fidelity (Hi-Fi) into Turkish.

en.who: Yüksek Sadakat is a Turkish rock band formed in 1997 by Kutlu Özmakinacı and became popular in early 2006 with its first album of the same name. Its music mixes pop rock with powerful beats, Turkish instruments, and keyboard and guitar solos. The band's name is a literal translation of High Fidelity into Turkish.
facts: The founder and bass player Kutlu Özmakinacı, used to be the editor of a music magazine called Blue Jean.

de.who: Yüksek Sadakat ist eine türkische Rockband, die 1997 von Kutlu Özmakinacı gegründet wurde und Anfang 2006 mit ihrem gleichnamigen ersten Album bekannt wurde. Ihre Musik verbindet Pop-Rock mit kraftvollen Beats, türkischen Instrumenten sowie Keyboard- und Gitarrensoli. Der Bandname ist die wörtliche Übersetzung von High Fidelity ins Türkische.
facts: Der Gründer und Bassist Kutlu Özmakinacı war früher Redakteur des Musikmagazins Blue Jean.
Der Bandname ist die wörtliche Übersetzung des Begriffs High Fidelity (Hi-Fi) ins Türkische.

tr.who: Yüksek Sadakat, 1997'de Kutlu Özmakinacı tarafından kurulmuş bir Türk rock grubudur; 2006 başında aynı adlı ilk albümüyle ünlendi. Müzikleri pop rock'ı güçlü ritimler, Türk enstrümanları, klavye ve gitar sololarıyla harmanlar. Grubun adı High Fidelity teriminin Türkçeye birebir çevirisidir.
facts: Kurucu ve bas gitarist Kutlu Özmakinacı, Blue Jean adlı bir müzik dergisinin editörüydü.
Grubun adı, High Fidelity (Hi-Fi) teriminin Türkçeye birebir çevirisidir.
